mia_fin: Heads-up: INV-2026-00722 billed VEGA Inc for full May reserved commit but their dedicated pool only activated 2026-05-09. Looks like full-month charge hit them. Can we review and propose remedy?

leo_billing: Pulling invoice now. Invoice shows reserved_commit $22,500; usage_overage $1,120; tax $1,512; total $25,132. Invoice date 2026-05-01 (system pre-billing).

tara_sre: Infra confirms pool activation event: `2026-05-09T08:21:17Z`. Logs: activation complete and health checks passed. No outage.

oliver_sales: Customer says they were told onboarding would be mid-May and expected prorate. Contract RWI-2026-VG section 2.1 doesn't expressly state prorate on mid-month activations. There's an onboarding note in the SOW though.

mia_fin: Simple math: May has 31 days; active from 9..31 inclusive = 23 days. Prorate factor = 23/31 = 0.7419. Prorated reserved = $22,500 * 0.7419 ≈ $16,692 => refund ≈ $5,808.

leo_billing: Billing engine charged full month because activation occurred after the monthly close. We can issue a negative line for $5,808 or process a cash refund. Standard is to issue a credit on next invoice.

legal-bot: Note: SLA credits are separate. If customer also claims p99 issues, we need incident refs. Contract says credits apply to "billed monthly fees". Legal prefers credit applied to billed invoice amount.

oliver_sales: Also customer reported increased latency 2026-05-20 for a 6-hour window; they submitted INC-2026-342. If SLA applies it's small — we should calculate.

tara_sre: SLO breach calc: p99 exceedance for the day was 12% on 2026-05-20. Monthly aggregated breach ends up at 2.3% due to single-day spike. Per SLA table that maps to 0.25% monthly credit (10-30% daily doesn't map cleanly, but contracting doc Appendix B: 1-5% monthly breach => 0.25% credit). I'll attach traces to billing ticket.

mia_fin: Options: 1) Issue prorate credit only ($5,808); 2) Issue prorate + SLA credit applied to billed amount (SLA credit = 0.25% * $22,500 = $56.25 if on full month, or *prorated $16,692 = $41.73 if post-prorate). Recommend we apply SLA credit against billed amount per Legal (so $56.25) and net refund = $5,864.25.

leo_billing: Agrees. I'll create AR ticket and post negative line: NegativeLineAmount = $5,864.25; GL reversal 4305-ReservedRevenue; SLA credit GL 5401-SLA-Credits; memo "Prorate + SLA credit - VEGA RWI-2026-VG"; Default apply as credit to next invoice; customer can request cash refund.

billing-bot: Created AR ticket AR-3418 and billing task TASK-8620 assigned to leo_billing.

oliver_sales: I'll send VEGA the proposed adjustment + math and offer immediate cash refund if they prefer (flag that CFO approval required).

mia_fin: Please include activation timestamp and infra traces in the AR ticket for audit. Tara pls drop trace links.

tara_sre: Added INC-2026-342 and trace IDs to AR-3418.

mia_fin: Thanks. I'll mark this resolved on our side once negative line posts.

oliver_sales: Customer happy with credit approach. Closing loop after AR posts. :white_check_mark:
